description: This file defines the LanguageConfigOverride class, which manages language configuration overrides in Drupal, including saving, deleting, and retrieving language codes, with event dispatching and cache invalidation.

classes.name: LanguageConfigOverride
classes.description: Manages language configuration overrides, including saving, deleting, and retrieving language codes, with event dispatching and cache invalidation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the LanguageConfigOverride object with dependencies for storage, configuration management, and event dispatching.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates data if not trusted, writes configuration to storage, invalidates cache tags, dispatches save events, and updates internal state.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the configuration, invalidates cache tags, dispatches delete events, and updates internal state.

methods.name: getLangcode
methods.description: Returns the language code associated with this override by extracting it from the collection name.
